theme: Myth-busting: common misconceptions about mutual funds, addressed simply
headline: Mutual Funds Need Big Money to Start
body: Myth: You need lakhs to begin investing. Truth: Many options welcome small, regular contributions from everyday investors.
caption: Starting your investment journey doesn't require a large lump sum. Systematic investing through regular deposits makes wealth building accessible to everyone. #MutualFundMyths #InvestmentTruths #SmartInvesting #MFBasics #DebukkingMyths
